children: CBOT soybean November contract (SX26) may retrace into a range of $13.01-1/4 to $13.07-1/4 per bushel, following its failure to break a resistance at $13.16-3/4.

The drop from $13.32 has been developing within a falling channel. The upper channel line establishes a resistance around $13.16-3/4, the 38.2% retracement of the uptrend from the $12.91-3/4 to $13.32 range.
Five small waves make up the fall. The downward wave 5 may have just started, unfolding toward $13.01-1/4. A break above $13.16-3/4 may lead to a gain at $13.22-1/2.
On the daily chart, the contract failed a few times to break a resistance at $13.31-3/4, the 123.6% projection level of a wave c from $11.65-1/4.

The failures suggest either an extended consolidation below $13.31-3/4 or the formation of a double-top. Signals on the hourly chart indicates a double-top, which will be confirmed when the market breaks $13.
